children: Restaurant Brands International reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $2.53B, net income of $542M and diluted EPS of $1.54, up from $2.45B, $315M and $0.96, respectively, in the prior-year quarter. System-wide sales rose 6.2%, with comparable sales up 3.8%.
¹ Reported as “Total revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income attributable to common shareholders”. ³ Reported as “Diluted net income per share”.
System-wide sales increased 6.2% in the quarter, while comparable sales rose 3.8% and restaurant count grew 3.0%.
Burger King comparable sales surged 8.3%, contributing to 7.6% system-wide sales growth; refranchising reduced its restaurant count.
International system-wide sales grew 9.0% and comparable sales increased 3.9%, reflecting stronger royalties and resumed Burger King China royalties.
Firehouse Subs sales grew 8.3%, supported by 7.8% restaurant growth, while Popeyes comparable sales declined 1.8%.
RBI plans to refranchise most Carrols Burger King restaurants, seek new investors for Popeyes China and Firehouse Subs Brazil, and sunset RH.
